issues.detail: The Greek 'μη μετακινουμενοι' (not being moved/shaken) is an adjective modifying the subjects (the believers), but the Vietnamese phrasing 'không bị lay chuyển khỏi hy vọng' makes it sound like a result or a conditional state rather than a descriptive attribute of their current standing in faith.

The Greek phrase 'εν παση τη κτισει' (in all creation) is rendered as 'giữa mọi sự sáng tạo' (among/amidst all creation). While similar, 'in all' implies a scope of existence/participation that 'among' slightly narrows.
